corrections.old_text: ፬ ፤ ⟪ኦ ፡ ዘማውያን ፡ ኢተአምሩኑ ፡ ፍቁሩ ፡ ለዝ ፡ ዓ
corrections.corrected_text: ፬ ፤ ⟪ኦ ፡ ዘማውያን ፡ ኢተአምሩኑ ፡ ፍቅሩ ፡ ለዝ ፡ ዓ
corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez scripture text in James 4:4 has the 6th-order ቅ in ፍቅሩ ('friendship/love of this world'), which was misread as 2nd-order ቁ.
The canonical Ge'ez particle of affirmation in James 4:7 is አሆ (1st-order አ), clearly printed without a bottom loop.
